title: Heat Exchangers
summary: Custom shell-and-tube heat exchangers, industrial condensers, process coolers and reboilers designed around project-specific process duties and mechanical requirements.
body:
Tongyang manufactures custom industrial heat-transfer equipment for process heating, cooling, condensation and vaporization. As a shell-and-tube heat exchanger manufacturer, we review equipment configuration, materials, maintainability and mechanical design requirements against the process data supplied for each project.

Types of heat-transfer equipment

  • Shell-and-tube heat exchangers: process heating, cooling and heat recovery
  • Industrial condensers: overhead and surface condensation duties
  • Process coolers and heaters: temperature control for process streams and utilities
  • Column reboilers: heat input for distillation and separation processes
  • Custom thermal equipment: project-specific configurations for defined operating conditions

Industries and typical applications

  • Chemical and petrochemical processing
  • Oil and gas processing facilities
  • Fertilizer and industrial chemical production
  • Energy, utilities and process heat recovery
  • Distillation, vapor condensation and process temperature control

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Both process streams: composition, phase, mass or volumetric flow rate, and fouling characteristics
  • Thermal duty: inlet and outlet temperatures, required heat load, or target approach temperature
  • Operating conditions: operating and design pressures and temperatures for each side
  • Hydraulic limits: allowable pressure drop on the shell side and tube side
  • Mechanical design: material requirements, corrosion allowance, tube dimensions and preferred exchanger configuration
  • Project interfaces: utilities, connection details, installation and maintenance space, inspection, testing and documentation requirements

Materials, engineering and manufacturing standards

Materials and construction details are selected according to the process medium, corrosion requirements, design pressure and temperature, and project specifications. The applicable pressure-equipment code and inspection scope are confirmed for each order. Depending on the project requirements, ASME Section VIII Division 1 and relevant TEMA requirements may be considered where applicable. PED conformity assessment or other regional requirements must be reviewed against the equipment design, destination market and agreed scope; they are not assumed to apply to every unit.

Thermal sizing, detailed thermal-hydraulic calculations, mechanical design and any performance guarantees require a defined design responsibility and adequate process data. Final dimensions, pressure drops, testing and documentation are confirmed during the engineering review.

Preparing a heat exchanger RFQ

To help us review your requirement, provide the process duty sheet and available PFD/P&ID, general arrangement drawing or mechanical specification. If some data are not yet available, send the information you have for an initial review.

Read our Heat Exchanger Data Sheet Guide for a practical checklist of process, thermal and mechanical information to include in your inquiry.

Quotation basis: the proposed configuration, design conditions, supply scope and delivery schedule are subject to review of the project specification and confirmation of technical details.
